name: Bad Thoughts
description: A collection of hilariously disturbing stories that push the boundaries of decency in ways only Tom Segura could imagine.

videos.title: Jobs
videos.overview: An assassin breaks all his own rules. A man takes serving the elderly to another level. An IT guy who's a little too hard at work.

videos.title: Success
videos.overview: A man succumbs to an apocalyptic evacuation. A behind-the-scenes day with an action icon goes wrong. A country star's jam session from hell.

videos.title: Family
videos.overview: A singer finds inspiration for a killer comeback. A school play that no parent could prepare for. An unforgettable night with extremely close sisters.

videos.title: Love
videos.overview: A French love affair takes a turn. A woman’s last wish blindsides her husband. A routine flight goes from turbulent to terrifying.

videos.title: Communication
videos.overview: An emergency landing becomes a miscommunication crisis. A groundbreaking video game returns with a vengeance. A coffee order no one can escape.

videos.title: Health
videos.overview: An offensive remark upends a work event. A man tries a new gym on for size — in more ways than one.

videos.title: Bad Impulses
videos.overview: A new wonder drug sends one man off the rails. An empty-nester steps into an unlikely brotherhood. A date crumbles over something in the air.

videos.title: Bad Perspectives
videos.overview: A body swap puts a dad between a rock and a hard place. A plantation owner misreads the signs. An airport ordeal unfolds from two perspectives.

videos.title: Bad News
videos.overview: A comedian bets big on a killer merch idea. A military canin's homecoming brings more than just tears. A fertility clinic visit spirals out of control.

videos.title: Bad Influences
videos.overview: A intimacy coordinator gets in on the action. A deadly mix-up upends a crime hit. A study-abroad student returns with some unexpected souvenirs.

videos.title: Bad Romance
videos.overview: A believer's trip to heaven isn't what she prayed for. A teenage boy gets caught in the act. An innocent couple orders a rideshare to remember.

videos.title: Bad Decisions
videos.overview: An unlucky traveler steps into the wrong TSA line. A comedian weighs the cost of a career-making movie deal.

awards: Nominated for 1 Primetime Emmy. 1 nomination total
